caption: The drawing features a single ceramic jug with a round, cylindrical base and a narrower neck that flares outward at the mouth. The jug has a substantial curved handle connecting the neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The coloration is primarily a muted beige with areas of slightly darker and lighter brownish-gray shading, giving the impression of a stoneware or glazed pottery finish. The jug sits centrally within a lightly outlined rectangular border, and the background of the drawing is left blank or off-white, accentuating the form and color of the jug. The surface of the jug shows subtle vertical streaks and spots, suggesting variations in the glazing. There are handwritten notes below the drawing, including a scale designation and a signature.
title: One Gallon Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
